title: Same jacket

caption:
Part 2. Different state. Same marker. Same yellow raincoat. 🌧️

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Ray saw a woman in a yellow raincoat at mile marker 41. When he stopped, she was gone. By morning his passenger seat was soaked.
scenes.image: an empty truck passenger seat soaked with rainwater in grey morning light

scenes.narration: Three days later, Ray was hauling freight through a different state. Clear night. Dry road. A different highway entirely.
scenes.image: a lone semi truck on a long empty desert highway at night under a sky full of stars

scenes.narration: Out of habit now, he watched the markers. Thirty-eight. Thirty-nine. Forty.
scenes.image: a trucker's tense eyes reflected in the rearview mirror, dashboard glow, dark road ahead

scenes.narration: Forty-one. There she was. Same yellow raincoat. Hood up. Thumb out. Dripping wet, under a cloudless sky.
scenes.image: a young woman in a dripping yellow raincoat on a dry desert highway shoulder at night, stars overhead

scenes.narration: Ray didn't stop. He kept both hands on the wheel and stared straight ahead as he passed. He didn't look. He did not look.
scenes.image: a semi truck roaring past a lone figure on the shoulder at night, motion blur, headlights

scenes.narration: At the next rest stop, he pulled the dashcam footage. He needed to know he wasn't losing it.
scenes.image: a man in a dark truck cab leaning toward a small glowing dashcam, his face pale in its light

scenes.narration: There's the marker. There's the shoulder. Bright in the headlights. Clear as day. Empty.
scenes.image: grainy dashcam-style view of an empty desert highway shoulder at night in harsh headlight glare

scenes.narration: No raincoat. No woman. Just gravel. And, exactly where she stood, a dark wet patch on dry asphalt.
scenes.image: a dark wet patch on dry desert asphalt at night, water glistening in headlights, nothing else

scenes.narration: Ray deleted the clip. He told himself he was done looking. Then he checked his mirror. Out of habit.
scenes.image: a trucker's hand hovering over a dashcam in a dark cab, his eyes drifting to the side mirror

scenes.narration: Far back down the dark road, something yellow. Walking toward the rest stop. Not hurrying. Not stopping.
scenes.image: a truck side mirror at night showing a distant figure in a yellow raincoat walking along a dark highway
